admission.lowering: The exact site reuses the production-qualified memory-SETcc emitter, which materializes the incoming flags before a final transactional byte write.
admission.boundedRule: The measured RIP, complete three-byte single instruction, SETNE condition, byte width, RCX base, and 64-bit address width must all match. An adjacent RIP or changed base declines.

verification.focusedGate: The expanded exact memory-SETNE matrix passes its tier-one differential and negative-admission checks.

verification.negativeCoverage: An adjacent RIP and the same operation with an RBX base both decline tier one.
